Controls are inherited as green; log reference only: .agent/run-331/task-18-controls-1.log.

No Contract or Final text block specifies a new signature, error or constant. The Current state marker identifies the first remaining test, which is removed as instructed; no production contract is changed.

Checked the closed decisions against the deletion: retiring window tests supports the owned headless-call transport and preserves the existing coordinating-session and fix-delivery surfaces. The diff changes no runtime policy, distributed go protocol, plugin authority, records, measurements or controls, and introduces no Claude invocation or replacement PTY resend mechanism.

Read all eight current CT370 convention documents and the backend repository conventions and conventions acknowledgement. Independently compared every removed it block with brief lines 195-212: exactly 17 authorized cases, comprising eight launch/sentinel/policy-dispatch cases, one no-resend budget case, four typed implementation-resume cases and four typed fix cases. No additional test or assertion is removed outside those bodies. These retain the transport-independent guarantees; shell sentinel, symlink, Enter and PTY resend details are explicitly retired rather than requirements for new fixtures.

The promised change is actual removal of the disconnected test suite, visible directly in the deletion; no fixture is introduced to simulate a production feature.
